scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the full complex polynomial spaces and fixed finite moments. It uses quantitative concentration and the deterministic ratio envelope from arXiv:2609.31779v1; it does not claim growing-order or exponential-moment control, nor a real-scalar analogue. Residual originality risk remains because the source is recent and an equivalent uniform-integrability observation may be stated elsewhere under different terminology.
title: Uniform finite-moment convergence of typical Bohnenblust–Hille ratios
